## 1. Executive Summary
This report analyzes student assessment metrics, examining the distribution of midterm and final scores, and evaluating overall academic standing using automated data pipelines.

## 2. Methodology & Metrics
- **Weighted Grading:** Final grades are computed using a weighted formula (40% Midterm + 60% Final).
- **Performance Threshold:** Students scoring a composite score of 60 or higher are categorized as "Passed".
